name: LGBTQ Connection
description: Free counseling, youth and older adult groups, family support, and trainings
fullDescription: LGBTQ Connection, a program of On The Move, supports LGBTQ+ youth, older adults, and families in Napa and Sonoma counties with free counseling, social groups, family and school support, and trainings.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free counseling and 1:1 support
- Youth socials and Youth Leadership Team
- Older adults group
- Family support
- School support
- Trainings for organizations
- LGBTQ+-affirming therapist directory
howToGetIt:
1. Visit or call the Napa office (780 Lincoln Ave, 707-251-9432)
2. Sonoma County residents can contact the Santa Rosa office (2800 Cleveland Ave, Suite C, 707-579-4327)
3. Check the website for youth socials and group schedules
4. Ask about free counseling and 1:1 support
keywords: LGBTQ Connection, Napa, Sonoma, LGBTQ, gay, lesbian, trans, queer, free counseling, youth socials, older adults, family support, school support, trainings
